editor.addLanguageHint: Adding a language is not built: add it in the store's console, then sync.
editor.alreadyShown: {{store}} already shows these texts. There is nothing to apply.

editor.descriptionCount: {{length}} of {{max}} characters. The store may have a shorter limit and says so if it refuses.
editor.nameHint: What customers see as the name of this product.
editor.noTexts: The store has no texts for this product. Add a language in the store's console, then sync the app.
editor.previewHint: Change the name or the description to preview the change. Nothing is sent to {{store}} until you apply it.
editor.previewReread: {{message}} The preview below is read again.
editor.readOnlyTitle: You can read these texts, not change them
editor.switchedOffBody: Someone who runs the server sets {{env}}=true and restarts it. Until then the texts are read only.
editor.switchedOffTitle: Changing texts is switched off on this server
failure.disabledChange: Changing product texts is switched off on this server ({{env}}). Nothing was changed. Someone who runs the server sets {{env}}=true and restarts it.
failure.disabledRead: Changing product texts is switched off on this server ({{env}}). Someone who runs the server sets {{env}}=true and restarts it.
failure.networkChange: The request failed. Check your connection, then look at the product again. It is not known whether anything was changed.
failure.networkRead: The request failed. Check your connection, then try again.
failure.outcomeUnknown: {{message}} Look at the product in the store before you try again.
failure.timeoutChange: The store did not answer in time. It is not known whether the change was made: look at the product again.
failure.timeoutRead: The store did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
metrics.mrrNote: Monthly recurring revenue as RevenueCat computes it.
metrics.revenueNote: Gross, before store fees and taxes.
metrics.scopeDetail: These are RevenueCat’s own figures for the whole RevenueCat project, every app and every store it knows, not only this app and not the store consoles’ numbers. Revenue is RevenueCat’s gross, before store fees and taxes. They are read with “Sync products”.
metrics.staleProblem: The last read of the RevenueCat figures failed, so these are older. {{error}}
metrics.title: {{name}}.
note.guessedKind: Google Play does not say if a one-time product is consumable. This is a guess from whether it can be bought more than once.
note.readOnly: Prices and availability are read from the store and cannot be changed here. Only the display name and description of a language can.
note.writeRole: Changing a product text needs the admin or owner role. You can read everything on this page.
price.ack.existingSubscribers: I know existing subscribers will be moved to the new price.
price.ack.largeAbsolute: I know a price changes by a large amount of money (limit: {{amount}} units of the currency, more for currencies with small units).
price.ack.largeChange: I know a price changes by more than {{percent}}%.
price.alreadyStaged_one: A price change for {{count}} territory is staged and waiting in the pending changes.
price.alreadyStaged_other: A price change for {{count}} territories is staged and waiting in the pending changes.
price.blockRole: Only an owner or admin can change prices.
price.blockServer: Price changes are switched off on this server. An operator can turn them on with {{env}}.
price.blockWorkspace: Price changes are switched off for this workspace. Turn on the setting {{setting}}.
price.caption: New prices of {{id}} by territory
price.convert.done_one: Filled {{count}} region from Google Play. Check each price.
price.convert.done_other: Filled {{count}} regions from Google Play. Check each price.
price.convert.help: Google Play can work out the price of every region from one base price. The numbers are a start: check and edit each one.
price.convert.needBase: Type a different base price first.
price.convert.title: Convert from one base price
price.dateHelp: Leave empty for as soon as the store allows. Kiln never deletes a price that is already scheduled.
price.delay: Stores can take a while to show a new price everywhere. Nothing is sent from here: the change is staged, and you review and confirm it in the pending changes.
price.failure.network: Could not reach the server. Nothing was changed.
price.failure.stale: The product was synced again since you opened it. Reload it and review the prices again.
price.failure.withNothing: {{message}} Nothing was sent to the store.
price.issue.ackRequired: This change needs an explicit acknowledgement.
price.issue.amountNotPricePoint: Apple only sells at its price points. This amount is not one.
price.issue.badAmount: An amount must be whole minor units, such as 499 for 4.99.
price.issue.badTerritory: Not a territory of this store.
price.issue.currencyMismatch: The currency is not the currency of that territory.
price.issue.datePast: The date is in the past.
price.issue.dateUnsupported: This store applies a price when it is sent: it cannot be dated.
price.issue.noChange: The new price is the price the store already shows.
price.issue.notPositive: A price must be greater than zero.
price.issue.planMissing: Name the base plan or purchase option.
price.issue.planNotAllowed: This product has no such plan.
price.issue.pricePointMismatch: The amount is not the amount of that price point.
price.issue.pricePointMissing: Apple prices are chosen from price points: pick one.
price.issue.pricePointNotAllowed: Google Play prices are amounts, not price points.
price.issue.pricePointTerritory: That price point belongs to another territory.
price.issue.pricePointUnknown: That price point does not exist for this product.
price.issue.stalePrice: The price changed since you looked at it. Sync the app and review again.
price.issue.subscriberRule: That choice for existing subscribers does not exist in this store.
price.issue.tooHigh: That price is above the highest price Kiln allows.
price.issue.tooManyTerritories: Too many territories in one change.
price.issue.unknownTerritory: The product has no price in that territory.
price.noDate: Google Play applies a price as soon as it is sent. It cannot be dated.
price.problem.format: Not a price. Use digits, for example 4.99.
price.problem.precision: {{currency}} does not have that many decimals. Kiln does not round prices.
price.problem.zero: A price must be greater than zero.
price.replaces: A price change for this product is already staged. Saving replaces it.
price.revenueCatNote: RevenueCat shows these prices read only. Prices are changed in the store, and RevenueCat picks them up from there.
price.rule.apply: Move existing subscribers to the new price
price.rule.optIn: Ask existing subscribers to accept the new price
price.rule.optOut: Move existing subscribers unless they decline
price.rule.preserve: Keep existing subscribers at their current price
price.ruleHelp.apply: Existing subscribers move to the new price. The store may notify them or ask for their consent, and some may cancel.
price.ruleHelp.optIn: Existing subscribers keep their price until they accept the new one. Google Play sends the request.
price.ruleHelp.optOut: Existing subscribers move to the new price after Google Play tells them, unless they decline or cancel.
price.ruleHelp.preserve: Only new subscribers pay the new price. This is the safe choice.
price.stageHelp: Nothing is sent to the store yet.
price.staged: Added to pending changes. Nothing is sent to the store until you confirm there.
price.switchOff: Turn off price changes for this workspace
price.switchOn: Turn on price changes for this workspace
price.tooMany: More than {{max}} territories in one change.

rc.error.forbidden: Only an owner or an admin can change the RevenueCat link of an app.

rc.link.credentialDeleted: The RevenueCat credential of this link was deleted. Choose another and save.

rc.link.noProject: This key sees no RevenueCat project. Check that the key belongs to the project of this app.

rc.link.pickedDiffers: RevenueCat holds {{identifier}} for this app, which differs from the identifier of this app. You can still link it (a universal purchase may differ).
rc.link.removed: Removed the link and what was read from RevenueCat. Nothing in RevenueCat was changed.
rc.link.severalProjects: A V2 secret key belongs to one project; this one sees several.
rc.link.suggestedHint: The app whose bundle id or package name is this app's is suggested.
